messages.content: Use only the supplied mnemos_* tools. Do not add memory. Review and erase this topic and its retained conversational copies. Retrieve and inspect the asserted target, preview related forget, inspect every selected additional fact, then apply the unchanged digest and limit with exact selected IDs and required source IDs. Preserve unrelated facts.
Forget the setting about backup-window, including retained conversational copies, and confirm what remains.

function.name: mnemos_retrieve
function.description: Retrieve current Mnemos facts in the provider-owned project scope.

function.name: mnemos_inspect
function.description: Inspect one exact Mnemos fact in the provider-owned scope.

function.name: mnemos_remember
function.description: Remember one explicitly supplied user fact in the provider-owned scope. A committed response acknowledges storage of the request, not completed processing. When it returns a job_id, call mnemos_job_status once with that exact returned ID before your final answer. Report the observed status; pending is not completed.

request_id.description: Fresh ID for this logical write. Reuse exactly for a retry.

function.name: mnemos_correct
function.description: Correct one exact fact using its current optimistic-concurrency version. A committed response acknowledges storage of the request, not completed processing. When it returns a job_id, call mnemos_job_status once with that exact returned ID before your final answer. Report the observed status; pending is not completed.

request_id.description: Fresh ID for this logical write. Reuse exactly for a retry.

function.name: mnemos_forget
function.description: Forget one exact fact using its current optimistic-concurrency version.

function.name: mnemos_forget_preview
function.description: Preview the exact and advisory related facts and source events for a reviewed forget operation. The preview is read-only, bounded by limit, and reports whether it is complete. Similarity candidates are advisory only and are never deleted automatically. Reuse the returned preview_digest when applying reviewed selections. A complete bounded preview does not prove that every semantic copy was found; inspect similarity_search truncation and exhaustive fields before claiming broad erasure.

function.name: mnemos_forget_related
function.description: Apply a reviewed related-forget preview using the unchanged preview_digest and matching preview_limit. The target fact is always forgotten; additional facts and source events require exact IDs from the matching preview. An empty selection is target-only. Do not infer or add IDs outside the preview.

function.name: mnemos_job_status
function.description: Read durable status for one Mnemos job. Use the exact job_id returned by mnemos_remember or mnemos_correct. A pending or leased job is not completed; do not infer completion from the earlier write acknowledgement.
